violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sinks produced a hot water temperature of less than 100 degrees F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The maximum temperature of hot water at the three vat sink was observed to be less than 110 degrees F
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater serving the food service establishment was not producing hot water of a sufficient temperature to provide hot water to the three vat sink at a minimum of 110 degrees F.,and to provide hot water to all handsinks at a minimum temperature of 100 degrees F.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. The water heater must be serviced and restored to fully functional condition. If the water heater must be replaced, contact the Health Department prior to installing the new water heater. MOBY DICK HOUSE OF KABOB (Inspection Date: 08/20/2025) Page 2 of 3
